entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. You've reached VeloFit, my name is Sarah. How can I help you today?
Hi Sarah. I... I need to return something. It's the VeloBand Cadence Sensor I bought a couple of weeks ago.

I can certainly look into that for you. I'm sorry to hear it wasn't a good fit. To best help you, could you tell me what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault with the device, or more of a preference issue?

It's not broken, it just feels so... hard to use. The data it shows is really confusing, and honestly, I just expected more from it. I've been a loyal VeloFit customer for a while, and this is the first time I've been disappointed.

I understand your frustration, and I appreciate your loyalty to VeloFit. I want to make sure you're getting the most out of your gear. When you say the data is confusing, can you give me an example of what you're seeing in the app?

Well, I read the user manual and it said it would show my pedaling speed. But when I'm riding, the number just jumps all over the place. It's impossible to follow. I thought it would be a steady, useful number. I'm just so sad about it, I saved up for this and I really could use that money back right now.

Ah, that's a very common point of confusion, and I can definitely clear that up! The default screen shows your real-time, instantaneous cadence, which is why it fluctuates so much. But there's a feature within the app to change that display to a 3-second or 10-second rolling average. It gives you a much smoother, more actionable number to pace yourself with. Would you like me to walk you through how to change that setting?
Oh. Really? I didn't see that anywhere. Yes, if you could show me, that would be great.
Of course. If you can, please open the VeloFit app on your phone. Go to the 'My Gear' or 'Paired Devices' section, and tap on your VeloBand Cadence Sensor.

Great. Now, you should see an option for 'Display Settings' or 'Data Fields'. In that menu, you can customize what you see during your ride. You should be able to select 'Cadence (3s Avg)' or 'Cadence (10s Avg)' as your primary display field.
Wow, there it is! 'Cadence (3s Avg)'. I've selected it. That's... that's exactly what I wanted it to do from the beginning. I feel a bit silly for not finding it.

Please don't feel silly at all! It's a powerful device with a lot of features, and we're always working to make them easier to find. I'm really glad we could get it set up to work for you. Does that resolve the issue for you?
Yes, completely! This changes everything. I was so ready to just give up on it. Thank you so much, Sarah. You've been a huge help.
You're very welcome! I'm happy I could assist. Is there anything else I can help with today?
No, that's all. Thank you again!
It was my pleasure. Enjoy your rides with the new display setting, and have a wonderful day!
